note: *os perigos do inferno*: an open row (D22); *abismo* and *mundo dos mortos* are the options.
*porque o Senhor te fez bem*: the stylist asked *te fez o bem*; kept as an option.
*Agradarei ao Senhor* can be misheard as *agradecerei*; *placére → agradar* is settled by D44, which names this verse.
